project.title: aquascape-wood-v2-views
project.description: Source-matched supplementary artwork for the accepted operator-reviewed V2 individual. Follow the exact master identity and pixel-art drawing.
project.art_direction: Retain the supplied master artwork's naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters and restrained palette. No CGI or photographic noise.
project.session_goal: Source-matched supplementary views/parts for artwork-led 3D construction.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: wood_back
asset.description: View the EXACT same driftwood from the OPPOSITE BACK side, orthographic camera level. Preserve every major branch, the twisted S main limb, bulging root crotch, short upward fork, stabilizing roots and frayed broken ends. This reverses left-right relative to the front image: long main branch now reaches to viewer LEFT and knotted base is to viewer RIGHT. Reveal the actual rear grain and root connection, no redesign. IMPORTANT: exact same individual driftwood and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

plan.prompt:
Subject: Exact same driftwood individual seen from the opposite back side: twisted S-curved main limb, bulging root crotch, short upward fork, stabilizing roots, frayed broken ends. Reversed layout — long main branch reaches viewer LEFT, knotted base to viewer RIGHT; rear grain and root connection revealed.
Silhouette: Full specimen with every branch tip inside frame, generous white margin, clean unbroken outline, readable twisted mass.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Naturalistic detailed pixel art matching the master reference; coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters, restrained wood-tone palette; no CGI or photographic noise.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Side view, orthographic camera level, profile facing right; no three-quarter or top-down angle.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Pure flat white #FFFFFF studio background, no border, gradient, vignette, texture or cast shadow; no ground plane; single specimen only.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No redesign or added branches, no alternate wood, no labels or text, no cropped tips, no transparent or checkerboard background, no multi-view sheet, no scenery.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
